_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Assessment of Manufacturing Risk and Readiness
summary: Specifies the format and content for a report identifying Manufacturing Readiness Level, associated manufacturing risks, and the strategy for mitigating those risks for program/system technologies.
use_relationship:
The Assessment of Manufacturing Risk and Readiness report contains an identification of the Manufacturing Readiness Level (MRL) of program/system technologies, manufacturing risks associated with those technologies at the time of the assessment, and the strategy for mitigation of those risks.

a. The Manufacturing Maturation Plan (MMP) identifies the steps and resources required to mitigate program/system manufacturing risks during development and implementation.

b. This Data Item Description contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: General
preparation_instructions.content: The Assessment of Manufacturing Risk and Readiness Report shall be in either an interim report or final report format as specified in the Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL).

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The contractor will determine the format for the Assessment of Manufacturing Risk and Readiness Report (text or annotated briefing). Format typically remains the same unless effective presentation would be degraded. The report shall be searchable with Microsoft Office or Adobe products.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Manufacturing Risk and Readiness Assessment report shall include:
